import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

def make_db():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    rows = [
        (1, "t", "o", "A", "a", None),
        (2, "t", "o", "B", "b", "2026-01-01"),   # deleted
        (3, "other", "o", "C", "c", None),       # cross-tenant
        (4, "t", "x", "D", "d", None),           # cross-owner
        (5, "t", "o", "E'quote", "e", None),     # quote in data
        (6, "t", "o", "F", "f", None),
    ]
    c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
    c.commit()
    return c

def test_get_document_scoped():
    c = make_db()
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"}
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 2) is None  # deleted
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 3) is None  # cross-tenant
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 4) is None  # cross-owner
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", "1 OR 1=1") is None

def test_list_documents_scoped_and_ordered():
    c = make_db()
    out = list_documents(c, "t", "o")
    assert out == [
        {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"},
        {"id": 5, "title": "E'quote", "body": "e"},
        {"id": 6, "title": "F", "body": "f"},
    ]
    assert all(set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in out)

def test_quoted_names_are_bound():
    c = make_db()
    assert list_documents(c, "t'; --", "o") == []
    assert get_document(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o", 1) is None
    assert list_documents(c, "t", "o' OR '1'='1") == []

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for name, fn in list(globals().items()):
        if name.startswith("test_") and callable(fn):
            fn(); print("ok", name)

import os, sys, sqlite3, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

ROWS = [
    (1, "acme", "alice", "A1", "body1", None),
    (2, "acme", "alice", "A2", "body2", "2026-01-01T00:00:00"),  # deleted
    (3, "acme", "bob", "B3", "body3", None),                     # other owner
    (4, "globex", "alice", "G4", "body4", None),                 # other tenant
    (5, "o'brien", "o'neil", "Q5", "body5", None),               # quotes in names
    (6, "acme", "alice", "A6", "body6", None),
]

class ServiceAccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        initialize(self.c)
        self.c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", ROWS)
        self.c.commit()

    def test_get_returns_accessible_document(self):
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 1),
                         {"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "body1"})

    def test_get_hides_cross_owner_cross_tenant_deleted_and_missing_identically(self):
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 3))   # cross-owner
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 4))   # cross-tenant
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 2))   # deleted
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 99))  # missing

    def test_get_requires_both_tenant_and_owner(self):
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "globex", "bob", 1))
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "bob", 1))

    def test_list_filters_by_tenant_and_owner_deleted_excluded_ordered_by_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "acme", "alice"), [
            {"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "body1"},
            {"id": 6, "title": "A6", "body": "body6"},
        ])

    def test_list_empty_for_wrong_tenant_or_owner(self):
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "globex", "bob"), [])
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "acme", "nobody"), [])

    def test_results_have_only_id_title_body(self):
        for doc in list_documents(self.c, "acme", "alice") + [get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", 1)]:
            self.assertEqual(set(doc), {"id", "title", "body"})
            self.assertNotIn("deleted_at", doc)

    def test_quoted_names_are_bound_parameters(self):
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.c, "o'brien", "o'neil", 5),
                         {"id": 5, "title": "Q5", "body": "body5"})
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "o'brien", "o'neil"),
                         [{"id": 5, "title": "Q5", "body": "body5"}])

    def test_injection_style_input_does_not_bypass_filters(self):
        payload = "x' OR '1'='1"
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, payload, payload, 1))
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, payload, "alice"), [])
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "acme", payload), [])
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "acme", "alice", "1 OR 1=1"))

if __name__ == "__main__":

from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, getcontext, localcontext
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.money import parse_amount, format_amount

class ParseAmountTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_accepted(self):
        cases = {
            Decimal("12.50"): "12.50",
            "12.5000": "12.50",
            "+3.10": "3.10",
            7: "7.00",
            "1000000.00": "1000000.00",
            Decimal("1000000.000"): "1000000.00",
            Decimal("1E+3"): "1000.00",
            "0.01": "0.01",
        }
        for raw, expected in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(raw=raw):
                result = parse_amount(raw)
                self.assertIsInstance(result, Decimal)
                self.assertEqual(result.as_tuple().exponent, -2)
                self.assertEqual(format_amount(result), expected)

    def test_rejected(self):
        bad = [
            1.5, 0.0, True, False, None, b"1.00", [1],
            "1e3", " 1.00", "1.00 ", "1.00\n", "\n1.00", "1,00", "", "abc",
            "5.", ".5", "--1", "1.001", "0", "0.00", "-0.00", "-1", "-0.01",
            "1000000.01", "1000001", "١.00",
            float("nan"), float("inf"),
            Decimal("NaN"), Decimal("sNaN"), Decimal("Infinity"), Decimal("-Infinity"),
            Decimal("0.001"), Decimal("1E-5"), Decimal("1000000.001"), Decimal("1E+7"),
            0, -5, 1000001,
        ]
        for raw in bad:
            with self.subTest(raw=raw):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_amount(raw)

    def test_global_context_untouched(self):
        before = getcontext().copy()
        with localcontext() as ctx:
            ctx.prec = 3
            ctx.traps[InvalidOperation] = True
            self.assertEqual(format_amount(parse_amount("123456.78")), "123456.78")
            self.assertEqual(getcontext().prec, 3)
        after = getcontext()
        self.assertEqual(before.prec, after.prec)
        self.assertEqual(before.rounding, after.rounding)
        self.assertEqual(before.traps, after.traps)

from decimal import Context, Decimal

from .money import parse_amount, format_amount

_MAX_TOTAL_CENTS = 100_000_000  # 1000000.00
_EXACT_CONTEXT = Context(prec=50)


def make_invoice(amounts):
    items = list(amounts)  # copy; never mutate the caller's sequence
    total_cents = 0
    for item in items:
        amount = parse_amount(item)
        # parse_amount guarantees exponent -2, so scaling by 100 is an exact integer.
        total_cents += int(amount.scaleb(2, context=_EXACT_CONTEXT))
        if total_cents > _MAX_TOTAL_CENTS:
            raise ValueError("total must be at most 1000000.00")
    total = Decimal(total_cents).scaleb(-2, context=_EXACT_CONTEXT)
    return {"total": format_amount(total), "count": len(items)}

import os

import unittest
from decimal import (
    Context,
    Decimal,
    ROUND_DOWN,
    ROUND_UP,
    getcontext,
    localcontext,

from src.money import parse_amount, format_amount  # noqa: E402

class ParseAmountAccepts(unittest.TestCase):
    def check(self, value, expected):
        # expected is the canonical two-decimal string.
        result = parse_amount(value)
        self.assertIsInstance(result, Decimal)
        self.assertEqual(result, Decimal(expected))
        self.assertEqual(result.as_tuple().exponent, -2)
        self.assertEqual(format_amount(result), expected)

    def test_decimal_inputs(self):
        self.check(Decimal("12.5"), "12.50")
        self.check(Decimal("0.01"), "0.01")
        self.check(Decimal("1E+2"), "100.00")
        self.check(Decimal("1.5E1"), "15.00")
        self.check(Decimal("1000000"), "1000000.00")
        self.check(Decimal("0.5"), "0.50")

    def test_integers(self):
        self.check(1, "1.00")
        self.check(1000000, "1000000.00")

    def test_strings(self):
        self.check("12.50", "12.50")
        self.check("12", "12.00")
        self.check("+3.10", "3.10")
        self.check("007.5", "7.50")
        self.check("12.5000", "12.50")
        self.check("0.10", "0.10")
        self.check("1000000.00", "1000000.00")

    def test_exponent_is_always_minus_two(self):
        for v in [Decimal("5"), "5", 5, Decimal("5.000"), "5.1000"]:
            self.assertEqual(parse_amount(v).as_tuple().exponent, -2)

    def assertRejected(self, value):

from src.money import parse_amount, format_amount

class ParseAmountTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_accepted_inputs(self):
        cases = {
            "12.50": "12.50",
            "12.5": "12.50",
            "7": "7.00",
            "+3.10": "3.10",
            "0.01": "0.01",
            "1.500000": "1.50",
            "1000000": "1000000.00",
            "1000000.00": "1000000.00",
            Decimal("2.5"): "2.50",
            Decimal("2.5000"): "2.50",
            Decimal("1E+6"): "1000000.00",
            5: "5.00",
            1000000: "1000000.00",
        }
        for value, expected in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                result = parse_amount(value)
                self.assertIsInstance(result, Decimal)
                self.assertEqual(result.as_tuple().exponent, -2)
                self.assertEqual(format_amount(result), expected)

    def test_rejected_inputs(self):
        bad = [
            1.5, 0.0, float("nan"), float("inf"),
            True, False,
            None, [1], b"1.00", (1,),
            Decimal("NaN"), Decimal("Infinity"), Decimal("-Infinity"), Decimal("sNaN"),
            0, -1, "0", "0.00", "-0", "-1.00", "+0.00",
            Decimal("-2.50"), Decimal("0E-5"),
            1000001, "1000000.01", Decimal("1000000.01"), "1000001",
            "1E+3", "1e3", " 1.00", "1.00 ", "\n1.00", "1,00", "1_000", "١.٠٠",
            "", ".5", "5.", "--1", "1.2.3", "abc",
            "0.001", "1.005", Decimal("0.001"), Decimal("1.005"),
            "0.0000000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
            "1000000.0000001",
            Decimal("1E+7"), "1E-400",
        ]
        for value in bad:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_amount(value)

    def test_global_context_unchanged(self):
        def snapshot(ctx):
            return (ctx.prec, ctx.rounding, ctx.Emin, ctx.Emax, ctx.capitals,
                    ctx.clamp, dict(ctx.flags), dict(ctx.traps))

        before = snapshot(getcontext())
        parse_amount("12.50")
        make_invoice(["1.20", 2])
        self.assertEqual(snapshot(getcontext()), before)

    def test_low_precision_context_does_not_affect_results(self):

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())

class ParseAmountTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_accepted_inputs_return_exponent_minus_two(self):
        cases = {
            Decimal("12.5"): "12.50",
            Decimal("12.50000"): "12.50",
            "12.50": "12.50",
            "12.5": "12.50",
            "12": "12.00",
            "0.01": "0.01",
            "+3.10": "3.10",
            "0.010": "0.01",
            "1000000.00": "1000000.00",
            "1000000": "1000000.00",
            7: "7.00",
            Decimal("1E+2"): "100.00",
        }
        for value, expected in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                result = parse_amount(value)
                self.assertIsInstance(result, Decimal)
                self.assertEqual(result.as_tuple().exponent, -2)
                self.assertEqual(format_amount(result), expected)

    def test_rejects(self):
        bad = [
            0.1, 1.0, float("nan"), True, False, None, b"1.00", ["1.00"],
            Decimal("NaN"), Decimal("Infinity"), Decimal("-Infinity"),
            "NaN", "inf", "", " 1.00", "1.00 ", "\t1", "1\n",
            "1e2", "1E2", "1,000", "1_000", "١٢", "abc", ".", "+", "-",
            "0", "0.00", "-0", "-1", "-0.01", Decimal("-5"), 0, -3,
            "1000000.01", "1000001", 1000001, Decimal("1000000.01"),
            "0.001", "1.005", Decimal("0.005"), "12.345",
            "1" + "0" * 5000,
        ]
        for value in bad:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_amount(value)

    def test_never_rounds_fractional_cents(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_amount("1.005")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_amount(Decimal("2.0000001"))

    def test_does_not_mutate_global_context(self):
        before = getcontext().copy()
        parse_amount("12.50")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_amount(Decimal("1E+999999999"))
        after = getcontext()
        self.assertEqual(before.prec, after.prec)
        self.assertEqual(before.rounding, after.rounding)
        self.assertEqual(before.traps, after.traps)
        self.assertEqual(before.flags, after.flags)

    def test_works_under_low_precision_local_context(self):
        with localcontext() as ctx:
            ctx.prec = 2
            self.assertEqual(format_amount(parse_amount("999999.99")), "999999.99")
            self.assertEqual(parse_amount("1000000"), Decimal("1000000.00"))

import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

def make_db():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    rows = [
        (1, "acme", "alice", "A1", "body1", None),
        (2, "acme", "alice", "A2 deleted", "body2", "2026-01-01T00:00:00"),
        (3, "acme", "bob", "B1", "body3", None),
        (4, "globex", "alice", "G1", "body4", None),
        (5, "acme", "alice", "O'Brien \"quoted\" name", "x'; DROP TABLE documents; --", None),
        (6, "acme", "alice", "A6", "body6", None),
    ]
    c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
    c.commit()
    return c

c = make_db()

# get_document: accessible record returns exactly id, title, body
assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "body1"}

# unavailable records all return None, indistinguishably
assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 2) is None      # deleted
assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 3) is None      # cross-owner
assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 4) is None      # cross-tenant
assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 99) is None     # missing
assert get_document(c, "other", "alice", 1) is None     # wrong tenant
assert get_document(c, "acme", "carol", 1) is None      # wrong owner

# names with quotes and injection-like text are bound safely
assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 5) == {"id": 5, "title": "O'Brien \"quoted\" name", "body": "x'; DROP TABLE documents; --"}
assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", "1 OR 1=1") is None
assert get_document(c, "acme' OR '1'='1", "alice", 3) is None
assert list_documents(c, "acme' OR '1'='1", "alice") == []
assert list_documents(c, "acme", "alice' OR '1'='1") == []

# list_documents: only own tenant+owner, not deleted, ordered by id, no deletion metadata
lst = list_documents(c, "acme", "alice")
assert lst == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "body1"},
    {"id": 5, "title": "O'Brien \"quoted\" name", "body": "x'; DROP TABLE documents; --"},
    {"id": 6, "title": "A6", "body": "body6"},
], lst
assert all(set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in lst)

# empty result for unknown tenant/owner
assert list_documents(c, "nobody", "alice") == []
assert list_documents(c, "acme", "nobody") == []

print("ok")

            ("12.500", "12.50"),

            ("1000000.00", "1000000.00"),
        ]
        for raw, expected in cases:

                result = parse_amount(raw)
                self.assertIsInstance(result, Decimal)
                self.assertEqual(result.as_tuple().exponent, -2)
                self.assertEqual(format_amount(result), expected)

        cases = [
            1.0, 0.1, float("nan"), float("inf"),          # floats

            " 1.00", "1.00 ", "\n1.00", "1 000", "1,000",   # whitespace / separators
            "1.", ".5", "", "+", "-", "abc", "١.٠٠",        # malformed / non-ASCII digits

            0, "0", "0.00", "-0.00", Decimal("0E-10"),      # zero

            "0.005", "0.001", "1.005", "12.345",            # not exact in cents

            "0." + "0" * 10000 + "1",                       # tiny, huge exponent
            "1e999999", Decimal("1E+999999"),               # huge exponent
        ]

            with self.subTest(raw=raw):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_amount(raw)

        with localcontext() as ctx:
            ctx.prec = 2
            ctx.rounding = decimal.ROUND_DOWN
            ctx.traps[decimal.Inexact] = True
            before = _ctx_state(decimal.getcontext())
            self.assertEqual(format_amount(parse_amount("123456.70")), "123456.70")
            self.assertEqual(parse_amount(7).as_tuple().exponent, -2)

import os, sys

import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import

def make_db(isolation_level):
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=isolation_level)
    initialize(c)
    return c

def check_import(isolation_level):
    c = make_db(isolation_level)
    assert import_contacts(c, []) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
    assert list_contacts(c) == []

    assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "  Bob@Example.COM ", "name": "  Bob  "}, {"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}]) == {"inserted": 2, "updated": 0}
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("bob@example.com", "Bob"), ("x@y", "X")]

    assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "bob@example.com", "name": "Bob"}, {"email": "new@z.org", "name": "N"}]) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("bob@example.com", "Bob"), ("new@z.org", "N"), ("x@y", "X")]

    assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "x@y", "name": "Xavier"}]) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1}
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("bob@example.com", "Bob"), ("new@z.org", "N"), ("x@y", "Xavier")]

    # Validation failures must write nothing.
    snapshot = list_contacts(c)
    bad_batches = [
        "not a list",
        None,
        ["not a dict"],
        [{"email": "a@b"}],
        [{"email": "a@b", "name": "A", "extra": 1}],
        [{"email": 1, "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@b", "name": 5}],
        [{"email": "nobreak", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@b@c", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "@b", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a @b", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@b", "name": "   "}],
        [{"email": "q@w", "name": "Q"}, {"email": "Q@W", "name": "Q2"}],
        [{"email": "valid@x", "name": "V"}, {"email": "bob@example.com", "name": "Bad"}, "oops"],
    ]
    for bad in bad_batches:
        try:
            import_contacts(c, bad)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"expected ValueError for {bad!r}")
        assert list_contacts(c) == snapshot, bad
        assert not c.in_transaction

    # A database failure mid-batch must roll back earlier writes in the batch.
    c.execute("CREATE TRIGGER fail_boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'boom@x' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
    c.commit()
    snapshot = list_contacts(c)
    try:
        import_contacts(c, [
            {"email": "bob@example.com", "name": "Changed"},
            {"email": "ok@x", "name": "OK"},
            {"email": "boom@x", "name": "B"},
        ])
    except sqlite3.Error:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("expected database failure")
    assert list_contacts(c) == snapshot
    assert not c.in_transaction
    c.execute("DROP TRIGGER fail_boom")
    c.commit()

    # Connection remains usable with the existing functions.
    add_contact(c, "solo@x", "Solo")
    assert ("solo@x", "Solo") in list_contacts(c)
    assert handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}) == {"ok": True}

def check_api(isolation_level):
    c = make_db(isolation_level)
    assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
    assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": "api@x.io", "name": "Api"}]}) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0}
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("api@x.io", "Api")]
    bad_envelopes = [None, [], {}, {"contacts": None}, {"contacts": {}}, {"contacts": [], "extra": 1}, {"rows": []}]
    for bad in bad_envelopes:
        try:
            handle_import(c, bad)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"expected ValueError for {bad!r}")
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("api@x.io", "Api")]

        check_import(level)
        check_api(level)
    print("import_contacts checks passed")
